prayers.title: 🙏 Thungetna Khawk - Pawlpi Thungetna
prayers.body:
Thungetna Khawk:-
(1) Pawlpi in kum 10 sungin missionary 10 i khahzawh nading
(2) Pawlpi mikim pianthak nading
(3) Pawlpi sungah guihtheih-khamtheih a beisiang nading
(4) Pawlpi mikim in Pasian it le zahtak-in, Pasian' thu sungah lawp-in nopsak na ding
(5) Pawlpi mite kha-thu le taksa thu ah khantoh semsem nading
(6) I gam le i khua Tamu ah nopna le daihna hong om mengmeng nading
(7) Biakinn thak lam zawh mengmeng nading

prayers.title: 🙏 Kah te a ding
prayers.body: I pawlpi thungetna 7 te a ding thungetna ah phawk ni!
